projects.title: NeoCalc: Interactive Scientific & Standard Calculator
projects.description: A high-precision web calculator with standard arithmetic, scientific functions (trigonometry, logarithms, powers), memory registers, calculation history ledger, and keyboard event support.
features: Standard arithmetic operations and scientific trigonometric / logarithmic math functions
Real-time calculation history drawer with memory recall and clear actions
Full keyboard event listener support (numeric keypad, operator shortcuts, backspace)
Floating-point rounding precision engine preventing JavaScript decimal inaccuracies

projects.title: Atmosphere: Real-Time Weather & 7-Day Forecast Web App
projects.description: A real-time meteorological weather web application featuring live temperature tracking, geolocation detection, dynamic atmospheric icons, 24-hour hourly precipitation curves, and 7-day extended forecasts.
features: Live temperature, humidity, UV index, wind speed, and atmospheric pressure metrics
Geolocation lookup with instant global city search and weather caching
Dynamic atmospheric visual themes shifting between sunny, stormy, snowy, and nighttime
7-day future forecast cards with high/low temperature ranges and precipitation radar

projects.title: Vogue & Thread: Modern Apparel & Cloth Store
projects.description: A full-featured responsive online cloth and fashion storefront featuring dynamic apparel collections, size & color variant switchers, instantaneous filter by category, cart checkout, and Stripe payment integration.
features: Curated apparel catalog with men's, women's, streetwear, and accessory collections
Interactive product detail view with interactive size guide and color swatch selector
Persistent shopping cart with live quantity manipulation and coupon discounts
Integrated checkout flow with Stripe payment intent API and order confirmation

projects.title: Haven Estate: Luxury Real Estate & Property Portal
projects.description: A full-stack real estate and residential property discovery platform offering interactive map search, price range & bedroom filters, virtual 3D tour viewports, and direct agent tour booking.

Interactive map view with pinned properties and instant preview hover cards
Virtual 3D tour photo galleries with high-resolution interior architectural showcases
Direct agent appointment scheduler and contact inquiry pipeline stored in MongoDB
